description: This file is a shell script designed for testing git merge-base functionality in a performance context. It sets up complex commit histories with merges to simulate costly history traversals, and then verifies merge-base outputs against expected results.

methods.name: build_history
methods.description: Creates a commit history with a tree structure of merges, simulating complex histories for performance testing.

methods.name: build_history2
methods.description: Creates a similar commit history as build_history but with a different merge structure to test multiple merge bases.
